title: Portal frame drift with ACI 318-19 cracked stiffness

rubric.text: The response should use 0.70 Ig for the columns and 0.35 Ig for the beam, include the flexibility of the beam (not a rigid-beam 12EI/h^3 assumption), and for the service drift multiply these stiffnesses by 1.4 (not more than Ig).

expert_notes: Slope-deflection or a frame model. Factored stiffness: drift 4.95 mm. Service: 1.4 x (0.70, 0.35) = 0.98 Ig columns and 0.49 Ig beam: 3.55 mm (= 4.95/1.4 apart from axial terms; slope-deflection without axial terms gives 4.92 and 3.51). Gross sections give 2.78 mm; a rigid beam with 0.70 Ig columns gives Ph^3/(24 E Ic) = 2.34 mm, both outside the tolerance.
